title: The Lock-in Hypothesis: Stagnation by Algorithm
findings: The paper found evidence of conceptual diversity loss in value-laden human messages over time, a trend that is accelerated by the release of new chatbot versions. Religion was one of the categories used to define concepts as 'value-laden,' but no findings specific to religion alone were reported.
